crossRefs.note: They have passed away as the swift ships, as the eagle that swoops on the prey.

translations.web: From there he spies out the prey. His eyes see it afar off.
translations.bsb: From there he spies out food; his eyes see it from afar.
translations.kjv: From thence she seeketh the prey, and her eyes behold afar off.
translations.asv: From thence she spieth out the prey; Her eyes behold it afar off.
